dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: 遅くなってごめんなさい
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for being late.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you, too.

dialogue.origin: 今から始めてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May we begin now?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: どんなことが嫌で学校に行きたくないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What is it about school that makes you not want to go?

dialogue.origin: とにかく行く気にならない
dialogue.content: I just can't bring myself to go.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いやなのです
dialogue.content: I just hate it.

dialogue.origin: いやでも行かなければって思うと辛いですよね
dialogue.content: It must be tough, feeling like you have to go even though you don't want to.

dialogue.origin: うん…
dialogue.content: Yeah...

dialogue.origin: 今は学校に行っていますか？それともお家ですごされていますか？
dialogue.content: Are you going to school now, or are you staying at home?

dialogue.origin: 家です
dialogue.content: I'm at home.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃から学校に行っていないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Since when have you not been going to school?

dialogue.origin: ゴールデンウィークあけてから
dialogue.content: Since after Golden Week.

dialogue.origin: 一月近く経つのですね
dialogue.content: So it's been almost a month.

dialogue.origin: きっかけとしては、どんなことが浮かびますか？
dialogue.content: What comes to mind as a trigger for this?

dialogue.origin: きっかけ？毎日憂うつ
dialogue.content: A trigger? I feel down every day.

dialogue.origin: それは辛かったですね
dialogue.content: That must have been hard.

dialogue.origin: 毎日憂鬱だと、学校にいきたくなるのも無理はないと思います
dialogue.content: If you're feeling down every day, it's understandable that you wouldn't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくなくなるのも無理はないと思います
dialogue.content: It's understandable that you wouldn't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうだけど
dialogue.content: I guess so, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 学校で憂鬱だなと感じたのはどんなことでしたか？あるいはどんなときでしたか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things at school made you feel down, or when did you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 友達
dialogue.content: My friends.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 友達のどんなことが憂鬱だったのかな？
dialogue.content: What was it about your friends that made you feel down?

dialogue.origin: 友達と話をしても楽しくない
dialogue.content: It's not fun talking with my friends.

dialogue.origin: それは残念ですよね
dialogue.content: That's disappointing, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: どういうことで楽しくないのでしょうか？話が合わないという感じかな？
dialogue.content: Why isn't it fun? Is it a feeling that you don't connect in your conversations?

dialogue.origin: 話をしても否定される
dialogue.content: When I talk, they dismiss or contradict me.

dialogue.origin: 否定されると気分が悪いよね
dialogue.content: It feels bad to be contradicted, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 例えばどんなことを否定されるのかな？
dialogue.content: For example, what kinds of things do they contradict?

dialogue.origin: うん本当に嫌な気持ちになる
dialogue.content: Yeah, it really makes me feel awful.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね
dialogue.content: I can understand that.

dialogue.origin: 自分が言っていれのはまちがっていないのに
dialogue.content: Even though what I'm saying isn't wrong.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 友達の方が私より上だといわんばかりに否定される
dialogue.content: They shut me down, as if to say they're better than me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね上から目線はムカつきますよね
dialogue.content: I see. It's frustrating when people talk down to you, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 友達と意見が合わないことが多いとストレスが溜まりそうですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like it would be stressful to disagree with your friends so often.

dialogue.origin: ストレスたまってるよ
dialogue.content: I'm so stressed out.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I can imagine.

dialogue.origin: それで行きたくなくなってしまったのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: That might be why you ended up not wanting to go.

dialogue.origin: それもそうだけど
dialogue.content: That's part of it, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: （お聴きしていますね）
dialogue.content: (I'm here listening.)

dialogue.origin: みんなキライ
dialogue.content: I hate everyone.

dialogue.origin: そうか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それはしんどいですね
dialogue.content: That must be tough.

dialogue.origin: あなたが学校に行きたくない気持ちがよく解りました
dialogue.content: I have a much clearer understanding now of why you don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 家では毎日どんな風に過ごしているのですか？
dialogue.content: How do you spend your days at home?

dialogue.origin: パソコンで動画みたりしている
dialogue.content: I watch videos on my computer and things like that.

dialogue.origin: 動画をみるのは楽しいですか？
dialogue.content: Is it fun to watch videos?

dialogue.origin: この頃飽きてきたかな
dialogue.content: Lately, I've been getting bored of it.

dialogue.origin: そうか毎日みてるとそうなるかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I see. That can happen if you watch them every day.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、あなたの学年と性別をお聴きするのを忘れていました
dialogue.content: By the way, I forgot to ask your grade and gender.

dialogue.origin: よろしかったら、教えていただけますか
dialogue.content: If you don't mind, could you please tell me?

dialogue.origin: 中学生の女子だよ
dialogue.content: I'm a girl in junior high school.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.origin: 家ではどんなことを考えていますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think about when you're at home?

dialogue.origin: 学校であったこと友達とのこと
dialogue.content: Things that happened at school, things with my friends.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そういうときは、どんな気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.content: When that happens, how do you feel?

dialogue.origin: どうしょうもない嫌な気持ち
dialogue.content: A helpless, awful feeling.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I can understand that.

dialogue.origin: 話を否定されたりして、嫌なことが多かったですからね
dialogue.content: After all, you've had many unpleasant experiences, like having your words dismissed or contradicted.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: 嫌なことを思い出してしまう、辛い日々を過ごされてきているのですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you've been going through some hard days, recalling those unpleasant memories.

dialogue.origin: ご家族に方とは、どんなお話をされていますか？
dialogue.content: What kind of conversations do you have with your family?

dialogue.origin: お父さんもお母さんも仕事だし、帰り遅いし
dialogue.content: My dad and mom both work, and they get home late.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お話をあまりされていないということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, does that mean you don't talk with them much?

dialogue.origin: 毎日つまらない
dialogue.content: Every day is boring.

dialogue.origin: それはしんどいですね
dialogue.content: That must be tough.

dialogue.origin: あなたとしては、これからどうされたいですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to do going forward?

dialogue.origin: そんなのわからない考えないし
dialogue.content: I don't know, and I don't even think about it.

dialogue.origin: どうしたいかわからなくなってしまうのは、とてもやるせないですね
dialogue.content: It must be very disheartening to not know what you want to do.

dialogue.origin: お父さんもお母さんもみんなキライなのとにかく
dialogue.content: Anyway, I just hate everyone—my dad, my mom, all of them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 誰か一人でも好きな人がいるといいのだけれどねみんなキライと感じてしまうのは、本当に苦しいことだと思います
dialogue.content: It would be nice if there were at least one person you liked, but feeling like you hate everyone must be really painful.

dialogue.origin: うん誰も好きじゃない
dialogue.content: Yeah, I don't like anyone.

dialogue.origin: そうかそれはしいどいですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be really hard.

dialogue.origin: 身近な人以外でもいいので、好きな人とかいますか？
dialogue.content: It doesn't have to be someone close to you; is there anyone you like?

dialogue.origin: いないよ
dialogue.content: No one.

dialogue.origin: あなたのとても、寂しくて、苦しい状況が伝わってきました
dialogue.content: I can really sense how lonely and painful this is for you.

dialogue.origin: 近くにいるおばさんが弁当持ってくるけど小言ばっかり
dialogue.content: My aunt who lives nearby brings me lunch, but all she does is nag.

dialogue.origin: 小言ばかりでは嫌になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Constant nagging would make anyone feel fed up, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: （なかなか統合に向えない中で、お時間が過ぎてしまいました）
dialogue.content: (Time has passed without us really getting to a resolution.)

dialogue.origin: そうですねありがとうございました
dialogue.content: That's true. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そろそろ終了にして、どんな風であれば良かったかをコメントいただければと思います
dialogue.content: I think we should end soon, and I'd appreciate it if you could comment on how it could have been better.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました勉強になりました
dialogue.content: Thank you. This was a learning experience for me.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそお世話様です
dialogue.content: Thank you for your help as well.

dialogue.origin: それではロールプレイを終了してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Well then, shall we end the role-play?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それでは失礼いたします辛口コメントをお待ちしています
dialogue.content: Alright then, I'll be going. I look forward to your frank comments.

topic.sub: 友達とのコミュニケーション問題
